description: The self-paced briefs study, both conditions, two situations each (holiday football week, foster homes for cats). Recorded with the live model through tests/e2e/study-briefs.spec.ts; replayed by the text each call is about, so the order of the situations doesn't matter.
steps: full: describe the form (intentToSchema), questions chosen by a committee of 4 drafts with their previews (generateDesignProbesAction), one answer applied from its preview, intent kept in step (syncIntentFromFieldEdit), conflict check
baseline: describe the form (intentToSchema), one typed change request per form (chatEditForm)
